1.english_reference: Then said the LORD unto me

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔ י
traditions.VUL: Et dixit Dóminus ad me :
traditions.KJV: Then said the LORD unto me ,

1.english_reference: Though Moses and Samuel stood before me

traditions.WLC: אִם יַעֲמֹ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֤ה וּ שְׁמוּאֵל֙ לְ פָנַ֔ י
traditions.VUL: Si stéterit Móyses , et Sámuel coram me ,
traditions.KJV: Though Moses and Samuel stood before me , [ yet ]

1.english_reference: my mind could not be toward this people

traditions.WLC: אֵ֥ין נַפְשִׁ֖ י אֶל הָ עָ֣ם הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.VUL: non est ánima mea ad pópulum istum :
traditions.KJV: my mind [ could ] not [ be ] toward this people :

1.english_reference: cast them out of my sight

traditions.WLC: שַׁלַּ֥ח מֵֽ עַל פָּנַ֖ י
traditions.VUL: éice illos a fácie mea ,
traditions.KJV: cast [ them ] out of my sight ,

traditions.WLC: וְ יֵצֵֽאוּ
traditions.VUL: et egrediántur .
traditions.KJV: and let them go forth .

2.english_reference: And it shall come to pass , if they say unto thee , Whither shall we go forth ?

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָ֛ה כִּֽי יֹאמְר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖י ךָ אָ֣נָה נֵצֵ֑א
traditions.VUL: Quod si díxerint ad te : Quo egrediémur ?
traditions.KJV: And it shall come to pass , if they say unto thee , Whither shall we go forth ?
traditions.DSS: ו היה כי יאמרו אלי׳ך אנ׳ה נצא

2.english_reference: then thou shalt tell them , Thus saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵי הֶ֜ם כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה
traditions.VUL: dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: then thou shalt tell them , Thus saith the LORD ;
traditions.DSS: ו אמרת אלי׳הם כה אמר יהוה

2.english_reference: Such as are for death , to death

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֨ר לַ מָּ֤וֶת לַ מָּ֨וֶת֙
traditions.VUL: Qui ad mortem , ad mortem :
traditions.KJV: Such as [ are ] for death , to death ;

2.english_reference: and such as are for the sword , to the sword

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לַ חֶ֨רֶב֙ לַ חֶ֔רֶב
traditions.VUL: et qui ad gládium , ad gládium :
traditions.KJV: and such as [ are ] for the sword , to the sword ;
traditions.DSS: ו אשר ל חרב ל חרב

2.english_reference: and such as are for the famine , to the famine

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לָֽ רָעָב֙ לָֽ רָעָ֔ב
traditions.VUL: et qui ad famem , ad famem :
traditions.KJV: and such as [ are ] for the famine , to the famine ;
traditions.DSS: ו אשר ל רעב ל רעב

2.english_reference: and such as are for the captivity , to the captivity

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַ שְּׁבִ֖י לַ שֶּֽׁבִי
traditions.VUL: et qui ad captivitátem , ad captivitátem .
traditions.KJV: and such as [ are ] for the captivity , to the captivity .
traditions.DSS: ו אשר ל שבי ל שבי ] ׃

3.english_reference: And I will appoint over them four kinds , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: וּ פָקַדְתִּ֨י עֲלֵי הֶ֜ם אַרְבַּ֤ע מִשְׁפָּחוֹת֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Et visitábo super eos quátuor spécies , dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: And I will appoint over them four kinds , saith the LORD :

traditions.WLC: אֶת הַ חֶ֣רֶב לַֽ הֲרֹ֔ג
traditions.VUL: gládium ad occisiónem ,
traditions.KJV: the sword to slay ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת הַ כְּלָבִ֖ים לִ סְחֹ֑ב
traditions.VUL: et canes ad lacerándum ,
traditions.KJV: and the dogs to tear ,

3.english_reference: and the fowls of the heaven , and the beasts of the earth , to devour and destroy

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת ע֧וֹף הַ שָּׁמַ֛יִם וְ אֶת בֶּהֱמַ֥ת הָ אָ֖רֶץ לֶ אֱכֹ֥ל וּ לְ הַשְׁחִֽית
traditions.VUL: et volatília cæli et béstias terræ ad devorándum et dissipándum .
traditions.KJV: and the fowls of the heaven , and the beasts of the earth , to devour and destroy .

4.english_reference: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth

traditions.WLC: וּ נְתַתִּ֣י ם ל זועה לְ כֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.VUL: Et dabo eos in fervórem univérsis regnis terræ ,
traditions.KJV: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth ,

4.english_reference: because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah

traditions.WLC: בִּ֠ גְלַל מְנַשֶּׁ֤ה בֶן יְחִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: propter Manássen fílium Ezechíæ regis Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah ,

4.english_reference: for that which he did in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.VUL: super ómnibus quæ fecit in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: for [ that ] which he did in Jerusalem .

5.english_reference: For who shall have pity upon thee , O Jerusalem ?

traditions.WLC: כִּ֠י מִֽי יַחְמֹ֤ל עָלַ֨יִ ךְ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.VUL: Quis enim miserébitur tui Ierúsalem ?
traditions.KJV: For who shall have pity upon thee , O Jerusalem ?

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ֖י יָנ֣וּד לָ֑ ךְ
traditions.VUL: aut quis contristábitur pro te ?
traditions.KJV: or who shall bemoan thee ?

5.english_reference: or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest ?

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ֣י יָס֔וּר לִ שְׁאֹ֥ל לְ שָׁלֹ֖ם לָֽ ךְ
traditions.VUL: aut quis ibit ad rogándum pro pace tua ?
traditions.KJV: or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest ?

6.english_reference: Thou hast forsaken me , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: אַ֣תְּ נָטַ֥שְׁתְּ אֹתִ֛ י נְאֻם יְהוָ֖ה
traditions.VUL: Tu reliquísti me , dicit Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: Thou hast forsaken me , saith the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: אָח֣וֹר תֵּלֵ֑כִי
traditions.VUL: retrórsum abiísti :
traditions.KJV: thou art gone backward :

6.english_reference: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee

traditions.WLC: וָ אַ֨ט אֶת יָדִ֤ י עָלַ֨יִ ךְ֙
traditions.VUL: et exténdam manum meam super te ,
traditions.KJV: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee ,

traditions.WLC: וָֽ אַשְׁחִיתֵ֔ ךְ
traditions.VUL: et interfíciam te :
traditions.KJV: and destroy thee ;

traditions.WLC: נִלְאֵ֖יתִי הִנָּחֵֽם
traditions.VUL: laborávi rogans .
traditions.KJV: I am weary with repenting .

7.english_reference: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land

traditions.WLC: וָ אֶזְרֵ֥ ם בְּ מִזְרֶ֖ה בְּ שַׁעֲרֵ֣י הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.VUL: Et dispérgam eos ventilábro in portis terræ :
traditions.KJV: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land ;

7.english_reference: I will bereave them of children , I will destroy my people

traditions.WLC: שִׁכַּ֤לְתִּי אִבַּ֨דְתִּי֙ אֶת עַמִּ֔ י
traditions.VUL: interféci et dispérdidi pópulum meum ,
traditions.KJV: I will bereave [ them ] of children , I will destroy my people , [

7.english_reference: since they return not from their ways

traditions.WLC: מִ דַּרְכֵי הֶ֖ם לוֹא שָֽׁבוּ
traditions.VUL: et tamen a viis suis non sunt revérsi .
traditions.KJV: since ] they return not from their ways .

8.english_reference: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas

traditions.WLC: עָֽצְמוּ לִ֤ י אַלְמְנֹתָ ו֙ מֵ ח֣וֹל יַמִּ֔ים
traditions.LXX: ἐπληθύνθησαν χῆραι αὐτῶν ὑπὲρ τὴν ἄμμον τῆς θαλάσσης ·
traditions.VUL: Multiplicátæ sunt mihi víduæ eius super arénam maris :
traditions.KJV: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas :

8.english_reference: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday

traditions.WLC: הֵבֵ֨אתִי לָ הֶ֥ם עַל אֵ֛ם בָּח֖וּר שֹׁדֵ֣ד בַּֽ צָּהֳרָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: ἐπήγαγον ἐπὶ μητέρα νεανίσκους , ταλαιπωρίαν ἐν μεσημβρίᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: indúxi eis super matrem adolescéntis vastatórem merídie :
traditions.KJV: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday :

8.english_reference: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly , and terrors upon the city

traditions.WLC: הִפַּ֤לְתִּי עָלֶ֨י הָ֙ פִּתְאֹ֔ם עִ֖יר וּ בֶהָלֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: ἐπέριψαν ἐπ᾽ αὐτὴν ἐξέφνης τρόμον καὶ σπουδήν .
traditions.VUL: misi super civitátes repénte terrórem .
traditions.KJV: I have caused [ him ] to fall upon it suddenly , and terrors upon the city .

9.english_reference: She that hath borne seven languisheth : she hath given up the ghost

traditions.WLC: אֻמְלְלָ֞ה יֹלֶ֣דֶת הַ שִּׁבְעָ֗ה נָפְחָ֥ה נַפְשָׁ֛ הּ
traditions.LXX: ἐκενώθη ἡ τίκτουσα ἑπτά , ἀπεκάκησεν ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῆς ,
traditions.VUL: Infirmáta est quæ péperit septem , defécit ánima eius :
traditions.KJV: She that hath borne seven languisheth : she hath given up the ghost ;

9.english_reference: her sun is gone down while it was yet day

traditions.WLC: באה שִׁמְשָׁ֛ הּ בְּ עֹ֥ד יוֹמָ֖ם
traditions.LXX: ἐπέδυ ὁ ἥλιος αὐτῇ ἔτι μεσούσης τῆς ἡμέρας ,
traditions.VUL: óccidit ei sol , cum adhuc esset dies :
traditions.KJV: her sun is gone down while [ it was ] yet day :

9.english_reference: she hath been ashamed and confounded

traditions.WLC: בּ֣וֹשָׁה וְ חָפֵ֑רָה
traditions.VUL: confúsa est , et erúbuit :
traditions.KJV: she hath been ashamed and confounded :

9.english_reference: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁאֵֽרִיתָ֗ ם לַ חֶ֧רֶב אֶתֵּ֛ן לִ פְנֵ֥י אֹיְבֵי הֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: τοὺς καταλοίπους αὐτῶν εἰς μάχαιραν δώσω ἐναντίον τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: et resíduos eius in gládium dabo in conspéctu inimicórum eórum , ait Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies , saith the LORD .

10.english_reference: Woe is me , my mother , that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth !

traditions.WLC: אֽוֹי לִ֣ י אִמִּ֔ י כִּ֣י יְלִדְתִּ֗ נִי אִ֥ישׁ רִ֛יב וְ אִ֥ישׁ מָד֖וֹן לְ כָל הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: Οἴμοι ἐγώ , μῆτερ , ὡς τίνα με ἔτεκες ; ἄνδρα δικαζόμενον καὶ διακρινόμενον ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ ·
traditions.VUL: Væ mihi mater mea : quare genuísti me virum rixæ , virum discórdiæ in univérsa terra ?
traditions.KJV: Woe is me , my mother , that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth !

10.english_reference: I have neither lent on usury , nor men have lent to me on usury

traditions.WLC: לֹֽא נָשִׁ֥יתִי וְ לֹא נָֽשׁוּ בִ֖ י
traditions.LXX: οὔτε ὠφέλησα , οὔτε ὠφέλησέν με οὐδείς ·
traditions.VUL: non fœnerávi , nec fœnerávit mihi quisquam :
traditions.KJV: I have neither lent on usury , nor men have lent to me on usury ; [ yet ]

10.english_reference: every one of them doth curse me

traditions.WLC: כֻּלֹּ֥ ה מְקַלְלַֽו נִי
traditions.LXX: ἡ ἰσχύς μου ἐξέλιπεν ἐν τοῖς καταρωμένοις με .
traditions.VUL: omnes maledícunt mihi .
traditions.KJV: every one of them doth curse me .

11.english_reference: The LORD said , Verily it shall be well with thy remnant

traditions.WLC: אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אִם לֹ֥א שרות ך לְ ט֑וֹב
traditions.LXX: εἰ μὴ παρέστην σοι ἐν καιρῷ τῶν κακῶν αὐτῶν
traditions.VUL: Dicit Dóminus : Si non relíquiæ tuæ in bonum ,
traditions.KJV: The LORD said , Verily it shall be well with thy remnant ;

11.english_reference: verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee [ well ] in the time of evil and in the time of affliction

traditions.WLC: אִם ל֣וֹא הִפְגַּ֣עְתִּֽי בְ ךָ֗ בְּ עֵ֥ת רָעָ֛ה וּ בְ עֵ֥ת צָרָ֖ה אֶת הָ אֹיֵֽב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν καιρῷ θλίψεως αὐτῶν , εἰς ἀγαθὰ πρὸς τὸν ἐχθρόν .
traditions.VUL: si non occúrri tibi in témpore afflictiónis , et in témpore tribulatiónis advérsus inimícum .
traditions.KJV: verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee [ well ] in the time of evil and in the time of affliction .

12.english_reference: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ יָרֹ֨עַ בַּרְזֶ֧ל בַּרְזֶ֛ל מִ צָּפ֖וֹן וּ נְחֹֽשֶׁת
traditions.LXX: Εἰ γνωσθήσεται σίδηρος ; καὶ περιβόλαιον χαλκοῦν ἡ ἰσχύς σου .
traditions.VUL: Numquid fœderábitur ferrum ferro ab aquilóne , et æs ?
traditions.KJV: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel ?

13.english_reference: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price

traditions.WLC: חֵילְ ךָ֧ וְ אוֹצְרוֹתֶ֛י ךָ לָ בַ֥ז אֶתֵּ֖ן לֹ֣א בִ מְחִ֑יר
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς θησαυρούς σου εἰς προνομὴν δώσω , ἀντάλλαγμα
traditions.VUL: Divítias tuas et thesáuros tuos in direptiónem dabo gratis ,
traditions.KJV: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price ,

13.english_reference: and [ that ] for all thy sins , even in all thy borders

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ כָל חַטֹּאותֶ֖י ךָ וּ בְ כָל גְּבוּלֶֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: διὰ πάσας τὰς ἁμαρτίας σου καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ὁρίοις σου .
traditions.VUL: in ómnibus peccátis tuis , et in ómnibus términis tuis .
traditions.KJV: and [ that ] for all thy sins , even in all thy borders .

14.english_reference: And I will make [ thee ] to pass with thine enemies into a land [ which ] thou knowest not

traditions.WLC: וְ הַֽעֲבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת אֹ֣יְבֶ֔י ךָ בְּ אֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֣א יָדָ֑עְתָּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ καταδουλώσω σε κύκλῳ τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου ἐν τῇ γῇ ᾗ οὐκ ᾔδεις ·
traditions.VUL: Et addúcam inimícos tuos de terra , quam nescis :
traditions.KJV: And I will make [ thee ] to pass with thine enemies into a land [ which ] thou knowest not :

14.english_reference: for a fire is kindled in mine anger , [ which ] shall burn upon you

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי אֵ֛שׁ קָדְחָ֥ה בְ אַפִּ֖ י עֲלֵי כֶ֥ם תּוּקָֽד
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πῦρ ἐκκέκαυται ἐκ τοῦ θυμοῦ μου , ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς καυθήσεται .
traditions.VUL: quia ignis succénsus est in furóre meo , super vos ardébit .
traditions.KJV: for a fire is kindled in mine anger , [ which ] shall burn upon you .

15.english_reference: O LORD , thou knowest : remember me , and visit me

traditions.WLC: אַתָּ֧ה יָדַ֣עְתָּ יְהוָ֗ה זָכְרֵ֤ נִי וּ פָקְדֵ֨ נִי֙
traditions.VUL: Tu scis Dómine , recordáre mei , et vísita me ,
traditions.KJV: O LORD , thou knowest : remember me , and visit me ,

15.english_reference: and revenge me of my persecutors

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנָּ֤קֶם לִ י֙ מֵ רֹ֣דְפַ֔ י
traditions.VUL: et tuére me ab his , qui persequúntur me :
traditions.KJV: and revenge me of my persecutors ;

15.english_reference: take me not away in thy longsuffering

traditions.WLC: אַל לְ אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפְּ ךָ֖ תִּקָּחֵ֑ נִי
traditions.VUL: noli in patiéntia tua suscípere me :
traditions.KJV: take me not away in thy longsuffering :

15.english_reference: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke

traditions.WLC: דַּ֕ע שְׂאֵתִ֥ י עָלֶ֖י ךָ חֶרְפָּֽה
traditions.VUL: scito quóniam sustínui propter te oppróbrium .
traditions.KJV: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke .

16.english_reference: Thy words were found , and I did eat them

traditions.WLC: נִמְצְא֤וּ דְבָרֶ֨י ךָ֙ וָ אֹ֣כְלֵ֔ ם
traditions.VUL: Invénti sunt sermónes tui , et comédi eos ,
traditions.KJV: Thy words were found , and I did eat them ;

16.english_reference: and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֤י דברי ך לִ֔ י לְ שָׂשׂ֖וֹן וּ לְ שִׂמְחַ֣ת לְבָבִ֑ י
traditions.VUL: et factum est mihi verbum tuum in gáudium et in lætítiam cordis mei :
traditions.KJV: and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart :

16.english_reference: for I am called by thy name , O LORD God of hosts

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי נִקְרָ֤א שִׁמְ ךָ֙ עָלַ֔ י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י צְבָאֽוֹת
traditions.VUL: quóniam invocátum est nomen tuum super me , Dómine Deus exercítuum .
traditions.KJV: for I am called by thy name , O LORD God of hosts .

17.english_reference: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers , nor rejoiced

traditions.WLC: לֹֽא יָשַׁ֥בְתִּי בְ סוֹד מְשַׂחֲקִ֖ים וָֽ אֶעְלֹ֑ז
traditions.VUL: Non sedi in concílio ludéntium , et gloriátus sum a fácie manus tuæ :
traditions.KJV: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers , nor rejoiced ;

17.english_reference: I sat alone because of thy hand : for thou hast filled me with indignation

traditions.WLC: מִ פְּנֵ֤י יָֽדְ ךָ֙ בָּדָ֣ד יָשַׁ֔בְתִּי כִּֽי זַ֖עַם מִלֵּאתָֽ נִי
traditions.VUL: solus sedébam , quóniam comminatióne replésti me .
traditions.KJV: I sat alone because of thy hand : for thou hast filled me with indignation .

18.english_reference: Why is my pain perpetual , and my wound incurable , [ which ] refuseth to be healed ?

traditions.WLC: לָ֣ מָּה הָיָ֤ה כְאֵבִ י֙ נֶ֔צַח וּ מַכָּתִ֖ י אֲנוּשָׁ֑ה֙ מֵֽאֲנָה֙ הֵֽרָפֵ֔א
traditions.VUL: Quare factus est dolor meus perpétuus , et plaga mea desperábilis rénuit curári ?
traditions.KJV: Why is my pain perpetual , and my wound incurable , [ which ] refuseth to be healed ?

18.english_reference: wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar , [ and as ] waters [ that ] fail ?

traditions.WLC: הָי֨וֹ תִֽהְיֶ֥ה לִ י֙ כְּמ֣וֹ אַכְזָ֔ב מַ֖יִם לֹ֥א נֶאֱמָֽנוּ
traditions.VUL: facta est mihi quasi mendácium aquárum infidélium .
traditions.KJV: wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar , [ and as ] waters [ that ] fail ?

19.english_reference: Therefore thus saith the LORD , If thou return , then will I bring thee again , [ and ] thou shalt stand before me

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֞ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אִם תָּשׁ֤וּב וַ אֲשִֽׁיבְ ךָ֙ לְ פָנַ֣ י תַּֽעֲמֹ֔ד
traditions.VUL: Propter hoc hæc dicit Dóminus : Si convérteris , convértam te , et ante fáciem meam stabis :
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the LORD , If thou return , then will I bring thee again , [ and ] thou shalt stand before me :

19.english_reference: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile , thou shalt be as my mouth

traditions.WLC: וְ אִם תּוֹצִ֥יא יָקָ֛ר מִ זּוֹלֵ֖ל כְּ פִ֣ י תִֽהְיֶ֑ה
traditions.VUL: et si separáveris pretiósum a vili , quasi os meum eris :
traditions.KJV: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile , thou shalt be as my mouth :

19.english_reference: let them return unto thee ; but return not thou unto them

traditions.WLC: יָשֻׁ֤בוּ הֵ֨מָּה֙ אֵלֶ֔י ךָ וְ אַתָּ֖ה לֹֽא תָשׁ֥וּב אֲלֵי הֶֽם
traditions.VUL: converténtur ipsi ad te , et tu non convertéris ad eos .
traditions.KJV: let them return unto thee ; but return not thou unto them .

20.english_reference: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall

traditions.WLC: וּ נְתַתִּ֜י ךָ לָ עָ֣ם הַ זֶּ֗ה לְ חוֹמַ֤ת נְחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ בְּצוּרָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Et dabo te pópulo huic in murum ǽreum fortem :
traditions.KJV: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall :

20.english_reference: and they shall fight against thee , but they shall not prevail against thee

traditions.WLC: וְ נִלְחֲמ֥וּ אֵלֶ֖י ךָ וְ לֹא י֣וּכְלוּ לָ֑ ךְ
traditions.VUL: et bellábunt advérsum te , et non prævalébunt :
traditions.KJV: and they shall fight against thee , but they shall not prevail against thee :

20.english_reference: for I [ am ] with thee to save thee and to deliver thee , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי אִתְּ ךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י לְ הוֹשִֽׁיעֲ ךָ֥ וּ לְ הַצִּילֶ֖ ךָ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: quia ego tecum sum ut salvem te , et éruam te , dicit Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: for I [ am ] with thee to save thee and to deliver thee , saith the LORD .

21.english_reference: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked

traditions.WLC: וְ הִצַּלְתִּ֖י ךָ מִ יַּ֣ד רָעִ֑ים
traditions.VUL: Et liberábo te de manu pessimórum ,
traditions.KJV: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked ,

21.english_reference: and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible

traditions.WLC: וּ פְדִתִ֖י ךָ מִ כַּ֥ף עָרִצִֽים
traditions.VUL: et rédimam te de manu fórtium .
traditions.KJV: and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible .
